act: Indian regulatory corpus (5,082 supplied PDFs: Companies, LLP, SEBI, GST, Trade marks, IBBI, RBI/FEMA, Income tax, Case law)
reviewNote: Questions and expected facts were drafted by an AI coding assistant and checked against the text of the named documents in the local full-corpus SQLite index on 2026-09-28. Every expected fact is a verbatim substring of at least one acceptable document, checked mechanically when the dataset was built. No case is lawyer-reviewed. Every indexed document has legalStatus unknown: expected facts describe the indexed text, not verified current law. Splits are frozen by family.
